name: Affiliate Store Credit Payouts Integration For WooCommerce
author: storeapps

sections.description:
Pay affiliate commissions as store credit (virtual monetary value) instead of cash with the Affiliate for WooCommerce plugin and Smart Coupons plugin integration.

Expand your affiliate payouts beyond PayPal, Stripe and bank transfers by sending store credit directly to the desired affiliates.

Select eligible referrals, choose ‘Coupon: Store Credit’ payout option and send. That’s it.

Affiliates can use this store credit at checkout to make purchases on your store until exhausted.

Note – You can send store credit payouts to affiliates automatically or manually.

Requirements

Install and activate these plugins:
* WooCommerce
* Affiliate for WooCommerce
* Smart Coupons

Join 5760+ paid users who trust Affiliate for WooCommerce you to set up and run their successful affiliate program. Track referrals, sales, and commissions, manage payouts, create campaigns and more from one place.

Trusted by 26200+ paid users, Smart Coupons is the original and all in one WooCommerce advanced coupons plugin. Enjoy discount rules, gift cards, store credit, BOGO deals, advanced restrictions, auto-apply and more in a single package.

Get your own money back

For example, if affiliate Robert Evans earns $82 in commissions, you can send him the same amount as store credit. Robert can then use it to make purchases in your store.

Ultimately, the commissions you pay as store credit are returned to you when affiliates make purchases.

Reduce cash payouts

Paying via store credit allows you to avoid instant and regular cash payouts to affiliates.

In case of free products, cash commissions can be costly, but offering store credit can attract more affiliates.

Tracking store credits

Affiliates will find the store credit coupon code in the existing email sent by Affiliate for WooCommerce plugin. They can also view their store credit balance in the My Account > Coupons section.

Additionally, affiliates can track their store credit payouts directly under their My Account in a dedicated dashboard provided by Affiliate for WooCommerce plugin.

No coupon hassles

When you pay affiliates with store credit, the corresponding coupons will automatically appear in the Coupons dashboard – no need to create them manually.

Prevent store credit misuse

Store credit payouts are restricted to the affiliate’s email address. This ensures that only the intended affiliate can use it for purchases in your store.

Note – You have full flexibility to pay affiliates using store credit – whether it’s a single affiliate, multiple affiliates, or all affiliates. Plus, you can switch payout methods effortlessly: pay via store credit this month, PayPal next month, and so on.

Get this plugin today and enhance your WooCommerce affiliate program!

Try our plugin demos

  • Affiliate for WooCommerce demo
  • Smart Coupons demo

And other free plugins

  • Affiliate CF7 Integration – Customize affiliate registration forms with Contact Form 7
  • Temporary Login Without Password – Create secure, self-expiring automatic login links
  • Smart Manager – WooCommerce Advanced Bulk Edit Products, Orders, Coupons, Any WordPress Post Type – Advanced bulk edit for WooCommerce & WordPress
sections.faq:
1. What other payout options Affiliate for WooCommerce provide?
  • Manual payouts via PayPal, Stripe & bank transfers
  • Automated payouts via PayPal & Stripe
  • Reward Points (only mark)
  1. Does Affiliate for WooCommerce support WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Yes. It allows you to provide commissions to affiliates on parent subscription orders and renewals.

  1. Can affiliate use store credit for subscription renewals?

Yes, store credit is applied at initial signup and if sufficient balance, it will automatically apply to future renewals until it’s used up. Works with WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin.

  1. Does this require any coding?

Not at all. It’s very easy.
